# ==========================================
# Third-party dependencies
# ==========================================

# ==========================================
# zlib
# ==========================================
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

set(ZLIB_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(
    
    zlib
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)

# Informar à libpng onde encontrar a zlib
set(ZLIB_ROOT
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/zlib;${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zlib"
)

set(ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/zlib;${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zlib"
    CACHE STRING "Vendored zlib include directories" FORCE
)

# O target depende da versão do CMakeLists da zlib
if(TARGET zlibstatic)
    set(ZLIB_LIBRARY zlibstatic CACHE STRING "Vendored zlib library" FORCE)

    if(NOT TARGET ZLIB::ZLIB)
        add_library(ZLIB::ZLIB ALIAS zlibstatic)
    endif()
elseif(TARGET zlib)
    set(ZLIB_LIBRARY zlib CACHE STRING "Vendored zlib library" FORCE)

    if(NOT TARGET ZLIB::ZLIB)
        add_library(ZLIB::ZLIB ALIAS zlib)
    endif()
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "O target da zlib não foi criado.")
endif()

# ==========================================
# libpng
# ==========================================
set(PNG_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PNG_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PNG_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PNG_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(
    libpng
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)
